Automatic Execution Paths

  • Based on the provided corpus, there is no evidence of .pth, sitecustomize.py, usercustomize.py, install-time setup.py execution, abused PEP 517 build hooks, or import-time malicious side effects.
  • src/ait/daemon.py contains subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "ait.cli", "daemon", "serve"], ...), but this appears to be a user-invoked daemon start path such as ait daemon start, not install-time automatic execution.

Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Stealth
